overview:
**High fire danger holds across the Montrose (High Elevation) area today, driven by dry fuels (ERC 82%, BI 75%) despite a slight chance of showers.**
- Danger stays High all week, with ERC/BI easing midweek before rising again by Thursday.
- Weak weather system brings scattered showers today into Sunday (50-60% chance), light winds, and a cooldown to the upper 70s.
- No Red Flag Warning is in effect; 0 of 7 local watchout thresholds are currently met.
- Stage 1 fire restrictions remain in effect on GMUG National Forest and BLM Gunnison/Uncompahgre Field Office lands (Gunnison, Hinsdale, Montrose, Ouray, San Juan, Delta, Mesa, San Miguel counties); Gunnison County remains in Stage 2.
- Nearby: Elk Fire near Lake City (Hinsdale Co.) is 7,257 acres and 52% contained, with area/road closures in place; Gold Mountain Fire near Ouray is 39,734 acres and 87% contained, threatening energy infrastructure with closures active.
